How to setup this app (don\'t skip)
These are things you need to setup yourself.\n(you can access this page anytime again from IMD Settings → Help button)
Setup what settings to hide per app first (MANDATORY)

For every app you need to individually configure what settings you want to hide first by adding them here:\na. Go to All apps → click on app name → Setting template, or\nb. Favourites → long press app name → Settings template.

Settings → App functions → Revert to default configuration lets you say which settings and services this app should switch back on, and which it should leave alone. Every Revert to default — the notification button, the in app button, homescreen shortcut, quick setting tile — follows what you set there, so it is worth a minute now.

The app will not touch any accessibility service until you say which ones. Settings → Accessibility Services → “Accessibility services to hide”, then tick the ones that should be switched off while a locked-down app is open. They are switched back on when you revert.
Setup Shizuku Start Intents (only if you use Shizuku)
If you use Shizuku service, whenever IMD will toggle off debugging settings it will kill the Shizuku service, so it is recommended to setup-verify Shizuku start intents in Settings → Configuration.
1. To use the blocked apps you need to launch them either from within the IMD app or via IMD created app shortcuts on homescreen.
2. In this app you can create app shortcuts directly to your homescreen by Favourites tab → long press on app listing → create shortcut.
3. IMD services manager - Use this service manager to quickly view the live status of your settings/services and also quickly toggle them on-off.
4. You can access IMD services manager and Revert to default function from the
a. Favourites tab,\nb. Android system quick settings toggles,\nc. Home screen shortcuts (long press IMD app icon then drag n drop the shortcut you want to add)
